question: What is included in the service desk?
html:
Our service desk is built on HELIX. The growth plan makes it a product-led service desk with a Tier-0 AI agent as the first line of support, plus a cyber-posture subscription and legal-AI enablement (Frontline growth plan). Our current data does not include a full service catalogue, so the details below cover only what we can confirm.

What the desk includes

ComponentWhat it isTiming
HELIX service deskCore desk, being rebuilt as product-ledPhase 1, months 0-12
Tier-0 AI agentHandles first-contact requests before they reach a technicianPhase 1
Cyber-posture subscriptionAdd-on security service for existing clientsPhase 1
Legal-AI enablementHelp moving AI tools from licence to firm-wide usePhase 1
  • Legal-AI enablement targets a clear gap. ILTA finds 68% of firms have Copilot, but only 8% have deployed it firm-wide (Frontline growth plan).
  • The first two add-ons are aimed at the AM Law base. Mid-size firms come next, in Phase 2 (Frontline growth plan).

Who delivers it

  • About 1,100 staff as of January 2026, with a large offshore base in Goa, Hyderabad and Cape Town (Frontline public filings).
  • More than 900 law-firm clients as of June 2026 (Frontline growth plan).

What we cannot confirm yet

  • Our data does not cover support hours, response times, support tiers above Tier-0, supported legal applications or pricing.
  • The data that would answer these questions:
  • the current service catalogue
  • client contract schedules
  • HELIX ticket-category and resolution data
  • There is no measured deflection rate for the Tier-0 agent. The plan assumes the agent and cyber attach lift EBITDA margin from about 15.4% to about 16.7% by month 12 (est.). It also states that revenue and EBITDA figures are analyst estimates, not company disclosures (Frontline growth plan; Frontline public filings).

The service desk is where the margin case starts. With a $90M term loan and an entry multiple of about 12-15x (est.), EBITDA growth has to carry the return, so every ticket the Tier-0 agent resolves matters (Frontline public filings).

Next actions

  1. Publish a one-page HELIX service catalogue covering hours, tiers, supported applications and response targets. This lets the assistant answer the question in full.
  2. Pull a baseline from HELIX ticket data now: volume by category, first-contact resolution and cost per ticket. This makes Tier-0 deflection measurable against the plan's margin assumption.
  3. Define the cyber-posture subscription and legal-AI enablement as separate offers with their own scopes. Then test attach rates with a sample of AM Law clients.
  4. Agree which desk elements carry into the mid-size "bundle" offer before Phase 2 outreach. The Mid-size law firms screen recommends that offer for its top-ranked firms.
